name: up v3 Factory
not_assessed: the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)
the protocol's total value locked (no DefiLlama match)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: A real 2-of-4 Gnosis Safe (v1.4.1, no module, guard slot zero, four bare-EOA owners) owns the factory and also holds swapFeeManager and unstakedFeeManager, with no timelock in the path. Simulated calls confirm it can call setOwner, enableTickSpacing and the fee-manager and fee-module setters, and its crossExposureScore is 100, meaning no signer shared with another tracked target.
narrative.detail: The same Safe is also the governor, emergency council and epoch governor of the Voter the factory points to, the team address of that Voter’s VotingEscrow and Minter, and the owner of its FactoryRegistry, so its reach extends beyond this one contract and the score covers only the factory’s owner chain. The contracts behind swapFeeModule and unstakedFeeModule were not traced, so any authority they carry of their own is not in the score.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
